title: Sounded off
text: Sounded off. So something about this just seemed off. The music seemed too fast, and also not long enough compared to other similar products. It seemed repetative. It also had some scratches on the sides out of the box. I do like the idea of it and my husband and kids liked it. And it is very reasonable, so as long as you know what you are getting, can be a reasonable option.
